questions: What is chiropractic care?
What does a chiropractor do?
faqs.answer: Chiropractic care focuses on the diagnosis and treatment of musculoskeletal disorders, particularly those affecting the spine. Chiropractors use manual techniques such as spinal manipulation to restore alignment and function.

questions: What conditions can chiropractic care help with?
Do you treat back pain?
faqs.answer: The practice's FAQ lists back pain, neck pain, headaches, sciatica, carpal tunnel syndrome and sports injuries, among others. The website also has symptom pages on back pain, headaches, neck pain and neuropathy.

questions: What happens during an adjustment?
How does an adjustment work?
faqs.answer: The chiropractor uses their hands or a small instrument to apply a controlled force to a joint in the spine or elsewhere, intended to restore proper alignment and function and relieve pain and other symptoms.

questions: Is chiropractic care safe?
Are there any risks?
faqs.answer: The FAQ says chiropractic care is generally considered safe when performed by a licensed and trained chiropractor. As with any healthcare there are potential risks and side effects, but they are typically minor and uncommon.

questions: How many visits will I need?
How long does an appointment last?
faqs.answer: The number of visits depends on your condition and how you respond; some patients need only a few and others ongoing care, and your chiropractor will build a personalised plan. The length of an appointment depends on your condition and the treatments provided; ask the doctor when the plan of care is presented.

questions: Do I need a referral to see a chiropractor?
Do I need to see my doctor first?
faqs.answer: In most cases you do not need a referral from another healthcare provider. Some insurance plans may require one for coverage, so check with your insurer beforehand.

questions: Can chiropractic be combined with other treatments?
Can I do physical therapy as well?
faqs.answer: Yes. The FAQ says chiropractic care can often be used alongside other treatments such as physical therapy, massage therapy and medication.

questions: What happens on my first visit?
I have never seen a chiropractor before, what should I expect?
faqs.answer: You will have a private conversation with the doctor about your concerns and go over your intake paperwork, then the doctor examines your nervous and musculoskeletal system. The doctor may recommend spinal X-rays, and may give a relief treatment at the first visit depending on your case. A later report of findings visit explains the results and your plan of care.

questions: Do you take insurance?
Which insurance plans do you accept?
faqs.answer: The practice says it accepts a variety of insurance plans, including private health insurance, Medicare and auto insurance in certain cases. It also has cash/wellness plans. For the most accurate pricing and insurance details, please contact the office.

questions: How do I contact you?
Can I text the office?
faqs.answer: You can call (303) 543-7700, or send a text or email through the website's Send us a Message option.
